svg.title: Renderers draw into FRONT; present() diffs it against BACK once per tick
svg.text: Renderers know nothing about the wire. The diff happens once, in one place.
A cell is one byte: a 7-bit glyph with the top bit (CELL_INV) for reverse video. FRONT is retained, so a tick that
draws nothing leaves the screen alone, and redrawing an unchanged row costs zero bytes.
